name: Double Leg Kick
summary: Face down with the hands clasped high on the back: kick both heels to the seat three times, then stretch the legs and arms back as the chest lifts.
steps: Lie face down, one cheek on the mat, hands clasped high on the back, elbows dropped.
Breathe out to kick both heels to the seat three times.
Breathe in to stretch the legs long, reach the clasped hands to the feet and lift the chest.
Lower, turn the other cheek and repeat.

layers.title: Kicks only
layers.text: Three kicks, head turned and chest down.

layers.title: Add the lift
layers.text: Legs lengthen, hands reach to the feet and the chest lifts.

layers.title: Hold the lift
layers.text: One breath up before turning the head the other way.

cautions.note: Hands clasped behind the back under load.
Keep the forehead down between sides.

cues:
Hips stay down as the heels kick.
Open the front of the shoulders as you lift.
Legs together.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Hands by the hips, not clasped
